programme.desc: Evil Pea adds a voice control feature to her Evil Peamobile, but when she calls it a nitwit, the car decides to teach her a lesson.

programme.title: 7-Man Army
programme.desc: In 1933, during the defence of the Great Wall at Gubeikou, seven Chinese soldiers are separated from their main force and tasked with defending the strategic outpost of Badaolouzi. Vastly outnumbered by Japanese troops and tanks, they make a last stand, fighting to the end in a powerful display of sacrifice and patriotism.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love or lust has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couples brothel.

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of woman warriors and a group of ruthless bandits. The maverick teams up with the woman warriors to battle the bandits seeking to raid the emperors tomb.

programme.title: My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: A corrupt official attempts to steal a priceless Buddha statue from a temple to please a group of Westerners. Luckily, Doctor Zhang and his son manage to defeat the Western boxers, the Japanese Kendo opponents and the Western longsword fighters with Chinese kung fu, thus saving the Buddha statue.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Aptly described by its original title of Money, Sex And Love, this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his masters rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gaos betrayal...

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperors sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: Oath Of Death
programme.desc: Three Sung loyalists become blood brothers to fight the tyranny of the Tartar invaders. To oust the oppressors altogether, Ma releases the kidnapped Tartar princess in a strategic effort to gain points with the invaders, but it soon becomes apparent that he desires both a great position and power, and will do anything to get it...

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xus until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shihs magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiaos fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: Two disciples, Yu and Zheng, are sent by their master to track down the invincible weapon Thundering Sword to prevent villains from getting it. Yu encounters the daughter of a ruthless clan, Chiao, who is on her way to seek for the sword. They quickly fall for each other, but when Chiao accidentally injures Zheng, things become complicated.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the ultimate witchcraft and teams up with his master to defeat them.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wens brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wens home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of womens rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Fu Hong Xue, a legendary swordsman, travels far to avenge his father, only to find the seven killers he tracks are already dead. Investigating with Yeh Kai, he learns they are alive, manipulated by disguise master Xiao Bie Li, who lures Fu into a trap. Yeh Kai aids him, but both end up trapped in a deadly blade formation.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen Lin Chong gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the bosss daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: That Man In Chang-an
programme.desc: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu. Liu sends his princess to Chang An to ask for help. The masked warrior protects the princess from attackers along the way and supports Liu to become the new Emperor.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Godfather of Canton
programme.desc: A docker, Lin Si Hai, accidentally saves Commissioner Cheng who then offers him a position in the police force. Lin is smart and soon rises through the ranks through treachery and corruption, before becoming a gangster.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: Its a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Sam is being hunted as he discovers that the mayor and the chief of medical bureau are colluding with a drug dealer. He is saved by a fishermen family and works in their friends grocery but the grocery owner is killed when the enemies track Sam down. Sam escapes to Shaolin to learn the cudgel style of kung fu in order to avenge his friends.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the directors previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killers claims of an evil spell, then it doesnt let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhangs custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Feis possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuks pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk an

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lians affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yips boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victims sister takes revenge by spiking the rapists drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperors eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Confession of Pain
programme.desc: When the billionaire father-in-law of veteran homicide detective Hei is brutally murdered, Heis wife, doubting the police investigation, hires his former partner and close friend, private detective Bong, to uncover the truth. As the case takes unexpected twists, Bong discovers the murder is mysteriously linked to Hei.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter the sole witness mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has posttraumatic stress disorder after his wifes death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firms VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macaus Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the citys casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called Kung Fu Stuntmen. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: The Mad Monk 1993
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Lets Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变.

programme.title: 爱情食物链 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳阮小仪样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业陈智燊渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬高海宁对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻金刚的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高郑子诚，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O记干探许浚森陈展鹏饰沈韦力黄智贤饰奉命调查跨国罪案期间，得悉杀虎案幕后黑手魏子乐张颕康饰落网前，曾将神秘讯息发送至暗网，并汇出巨额加密货币不久有神秘人策动恐袭，浚森与韦力纵于天才教授唐冠峰方力申饰协助下破案，却惊觉子乐背后藏着更大阴谋！他们要竭力阻止子乐的同时，也遇到龙头棍风暴空屋藏白骨重犯越狱等奇案，能否一一扫除险阻？工作上面对的危机升级，感情亦遇挑战，浚森望跟前女友马颖思林夏薇饰复合，但困难重重令二人关系出现变量.

programme.title: 大酱园 Dripping Sauce, The
programme.desc: 万冠园是佛山酱油业百年老字号，大当家万启山吴岱融饰与夫人席德容龚慈恩饰坚持传男不传女，传内不传外的宗旨，可是一宗毒酱油事故，使他不得不答应让夏小满朱晨丽饰及叶细么龚嘉欣饰两女子加入，与其子万卓枫何广沛饰成为同期学徒三人与酱园小师傅华歌吴业坤饰建立了复杂的四角关系，又间接揭发了万家多个秘密，加上卓枫突然被掳走，人心惶惶酱园内，启山几个弟弟启石郑子诚饰启川陈嘉辉饰及启江徐荣饰酝酿分家，酱园外，专员高兆荣袁文杰饰也密谋夺取酱园财产，万冠园百年基业随时毁于一旦！.

programme.desc: O记干探许浚森陈展鹏饰沈韦力黄智贤饰奉命调查跨国罪案期间，得悉杀虎案幕后黑手魏子乐张颕康饰落网前，曾将神秘讯息发送至暗网，并汇出巨额加密货币不久有神秘人策动恐袭，浚森与韦力纵于天才教授唐冠峰方力申饰协助下破案，却惊觉子乐背后藏着更大阴谋！他们要竭力阻止子乐的同时，也遇到龙头棍风暴空屋藏白骨重犯越狱等奇案，能否一一扫除险阻？工作上面对的危机升级，感情亦遇挑战，浚森望跟前女友马颖思林夏薇饰复合，但困难重重令二人关系出现变量.

programme.title: 大酱园 Dripping Sauce, The
programme.desc: 万冠园是佛山酱油业百年老字号，大当家万启山吴岱融饰与夫人席德容龚慈恩饰坚持传男不传女，传内不传外的宗旨，可是一宗毒酱油事故，使他不得不答应让夏小满朱晨丽饰及叶细么龚嘉欣饰两女子加入，与其子万卓枫何广沛饰成为同期学徒三人与酱园小师傅华歌吴业坤饰建立了复杂的四角关系，又间接揭发了万家多个秘密，加上卓枫突然被掳走，人心惶惶酱园内，启山几个弟弟启石郑子诚饰启川陈嘉辉饰及启江徐荣饰酝酿分家，酱园外，专员高兆荣袁文杰饰也密谋夺取酱园财产，万冠园百年基业随时毁于一旦！.

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人 Life After Death
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变.

programme.title: 丫鬟大联盟 Handmaidens United
programme.desc: 以兵部侍郎裘府丫鬟月盈黄心颖饰为首的六部丫鬟组成联盟，互通消息，一起赚钱月皎汤洛雯饰为筹钱给爱郎傅有为谢东闵饰上京赴考，卖身为婢月盈与月皎分别服侍大夫人官之姵郭少芸饰和二夫人上官云英张慧仪饰，各为其主，互相斗法！少爷裘其进洪永城饰与月盈情投意合，可惜遭父裘正郑子诚饰打压裘正犯事被降职，其进决心考取功名，重振家声兵部尚书霍奔潘志文饰之女霍燕贞刘思希饰也看上有为，多番引诱月盈月皎害怕情郎高中后失去对方，誓要他们状元梦碎两对恋人面临决裂之际，竟卷入卖国漩涡中.

programme.title: 他来自江湖 Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复.

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨......胡亭轩为助窦胜雪忘却不快，安排她在胡府经营的盐栈工作，而窦胜雪为报答胡亭轩救命之恩，不计劳苦为盐栈出心出力，那段日子令胡亭轩对窦胜雪由怜生爱，却碍于恶疾缠身，一直未敢表白，直至窦胜雪的二叔突然现身，暴露了窦胜雪的真正身份，胡亭轩为防家人报官竟向窦胜雪提亲......

programme.title: 八卦神探 Officer Geomancer
programme.desc: 薛丹仁李思捷是一名普通警员，但他非等闲之辈，因他在玄学上深得外公真传，每每在关键时刻，为许多奇案破解谜团，加上黑白通吃的好友梁醒裘梁烈唯作线人，其出众的作风常令上司车季菲万绮雯啧啧称奇，季菲拥有犯罪心理学专家资格，事事只凭理性，二人看似南辕北辙，但内里却因合作蕴酿了一种不能言语的默契，但季菲一副管家婆模样，工作以外只关心妹妹车季美杨诗敏和弟弟车季君郑俊弘的终身大事，当季美陷入醒裘和下属铁良芷朱晨丽的三角关系时，季菲情绪失控，幸得丹仁出手相助此际，城中发生连环失踪案，诱拐手法勾起了丹仁隐藏多年的往事，季菲不惜以身犯险，丹仁却算到.

programme.title: Janji Arissa
programme.desc: Arissa mula mencari maklumat tentang AR Holdings. Fendi pula mula membuat video tentang produk AR Holdings yang memberi kesan negative kepada para pengguna. Arissa melihat akan kebaikan Muhammad dan mula berubah fikiran terhadap Muhammad.

programme.title: Anggun Mikayla
programme.desc: Mikayla, seorang gadis cantik berambut merah dan bermata biru, dilahirkan di luar nikah dan dinafikan kewujudannya oleh ibu kandungnya, Datin Asmidar. Dibesarkan oleh ibu saudaranya, Suraya, Mikayla sering dihina dan dipinggir oleh keluarganya. Tekad mencari kasih sayang ibu kandungnya membawa Mikayla ke Kuala Lumpur, di mana dia bekerja sebagai jurusolek dan dalam masa yang sama, menjadi hantu di pesta ria milik Uncle Jon.

programme.title: Anggun Mikayla
programme.desc: Pertemuan tak disangka dengan Idriz, seorang penghantar makanan yang kelakar, mencetuskan hubungan istimewa. Idriz terpikat dengan kebaikan dan keanggunan Mikayla

programme.title: Anggun Mikayla
programme.desc: Asif, rakan yang bekerja bersama Mikayla, mula sedar perasaannya lebih daripada sekadar kawan. Namun, dia berdepan dilema untuk menyatakan perasaannya

programme.title: Anggun Mikayla
programme.desc: Kemunculan seorang lelaki dari masa lalu Mikayla menambahkan konflik antara Asif dan Idriz, masing-masing berjuang untuk merebut tempat di hati Mikayla.

programme.title: Rembulan Tenggelam Di Wajahmu
programme.desc: Ray, seorang pemilik konglomerat berusia 60 tahun yang kaya-raya tetapi kesepian, kini sakit tenat dan terlantar di hospital menanti ajal. Semasa berada di ambang maut, seorang lelaki misteri berwajah samar muncul lalu membawanya mengembara secara spiritual ke masa lampau. Sambil mengimbau kembali detik kejayaan serta kedukaan pada zaman mudanya, Ray cuba mencari jawapan kepada lima persoalan besar tentang kehidupan, takdir, dan keadilan yang selama ini sering dipersoalkannya kepada Tuhan.

programme.title: Celebs Day Off
programme.desc: Saksikan bagaimana seorang selebriti mengisi hari cuti mereka dengan bermacam aktiviti-aktiviti menarik. Dihoskan oleh Asmawi, anda akan mengenali lebih lanjut kisah kehidupan dan karier tetamu undangan kali ini, Natasha Elyzza.

programme.title: Trendsetter
programme.desc: Trendsetter adalah rancangan mengenai trend fesyen dan gaya hidup. Kini kembali dalam musim terbaru bersama pengacara Zakuan Zainal. Episod kalini menampilkan Uncommon dalam segment Usha Kedai, Ambush Event LahLahLand dan Bedah Kotak 2timestoo - Double Knee Denim Pants

programme.title: Concert Dia.. Lagenda Unplugged Salimah Mahmood
programme.desc: Dalam rancangan ini, Salimah Mahmood berkongsi pelbagai cerita permulaan penglibatannya di dalam dunia seni nyanyian.

programme.title: Mariposa
programme.desc: Acha, pelajar baharu yang ceria dan penuh tekad, jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Iqbal, seorang pelajar pintar yang terkenal dengan sikapnya yang sangat dingin. Iqbal diibaratkan seperti seekor rama-rama Mariposa, setiap kali cuba didekati, dia pasti akan melarikan diri. Walaupun sering ditolak oleh Iqbal, Acha tetap enggan berputus asa, tanpa menyedari bahawa Iqbal sebenarnya sedang bergelut dengan tekanan berat daripada keluarganya.

programme.title: Janji Arissa
programme.desc: Fendi kecewa dengan Arissa. Fendi menghantar gambar Shida dan Shariff bersama kepada Muhammad. Shahira dan TJ mula bertengkar dan TJ memutuskan pertunangan mereka. TJ pula ingin mengenali Arissa dengan lebih rapat. Fendi tahu akan keretakan hubungan Shahira dan TJ mula memujuk Shahira untuk bersama-sama menjatuhkan AR Holdings.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Antasya memujuk Syarfan supaya membenarkan Hana tinggal bersama mereka. Hana berdendam dan ingin memusnahkan kebahagiaan Antasya. Dia sering menimbulkan salah faham atara Syarfan dan Antsya sehingga rumahtangga mereka bergelora. Razali mula meracau apabila Datin Jasmin pulang.

programme.title: Akil juan
programme.desc: Juan, remaja Sarawak yang bercita-cita menjadi askar, ke Kuala Lumpur dan membantu kerja amal bersama abangnya. Di sana, dia mengenali Akil, rakan sebaya yang hidup susah dan berkorban demi keluarga, membuka mata Juan tentang realiti kehidupan bandar.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Iskandar pergi meninggalkan Aisyah, dia mahu menenangkan hatinya. Hatinya sakit apabila segala khilafnya selama ini tidak dapat di tebus disebabkan Aisyah tidak mempunyai memori bersamanya. Berat langkah yang dibawa oleh Iskandar, dia sangat berharap akan ketenangan yang bakal ditemuinya setibanya dia di Villa rahsia miliknya. Kepergian Iskandar menyentap hati Aisyah yang sedang mencuba dan berusaha untuk menerima Iskandar dalam hidupnya. Aisyah tersandar lemah, dia tidak tahu kenapa dia merasakan dia telah hilang tempat untuk dia berpaut. Hati Aisyah luluh apabila dia melihat pakaian Iskandar di bawa bersama. Aisyah mula merasa akan kehilangan yang berat itu. Tengku Maria dimaklumkan oleh Iskandar tentang kepergiaannya dari kondo itu dan meninggalkan Aisyah. Tengku Maria memarahi Iskandar tetapi keputusan Iskandar muktamad untuk mencari ketenangan demi sebuah jawapan. Aisyah mengajak Tengku Maria mencari Iskandar tetapi Tengku Maria terpaksa menolak dan berpura tidak mengetahui kemana perginya Iskandar. Aisyah enggan tinggal bersama Tengku Maria, dia mahu menunggu kepulangan Iskandar di kondo itu. Haziq dan Waiduri merayu kepada Tengku Maria untuk memberitahu tempat di mana Iskandar tinggal. Haziq dan Waiduri pergi ke Villa itu dan menasihati Iskandar namun gagal. Melihat keadaan Aisyah, Tengku Maria mengambil keputusan untuk membawa Aisyah ke Villa itu dan menemukan Aisyah dengan Iskandar.

programme.desc: Farah dibawa pulang ke Malaysia setelah mengalami keguguran. Dia mengalami tekanan jiwa dan ada sindrom meroyan lantaran terlalu sedih dengan kehilangan tersebut. Dia seakan hilang siapa dirinya hingga meresahkan orang-orang di sekeliling. Namun, dia menafikan bahawa dirinya sakit. Musibah yang menimpa menyebabkan Farah semakin membenci Lukman meskipun Lukman sudah berusaha untuk berdamai dengannya. Joshua pula sanggup bertindak mencederakan Myra setelah Myra berterus terang dengan Lukman dan Budi mengenai apa sebenarnya yang berlaku. Nazim pulang ke kampung untuk urusan pernikahan adiknya. Farah bersungguh mahu mengikut Nazim pulang ke Manchester dan mendesak Lukman melepaskannya. Dia benar-benar tawar hati meskipun Lukman sudah insaf dan terus merayu agar Farah memberikan peluang kedua kepadanya.

programme.title: Satu, DuaDia?
programme.desc: Mia mula menulis blog gosip Ma Belle, dan artikel tentang Isa mencetuskan kontroversi.

programme.title: Kelibat
programme.desc: Kesilapannya mungkin menyebabkan dia dipenjara, tetapi bagi Firman, ia juga menjadi pemangkin permulaan baru dalam hidup. Trisya seorang gadis yang mendambakan untuk dicintai, tetapi apabila bertemu dengannya barulah dia sedar bahawa cinta sejati bukanlah hamparan bunga mawar. Freez adalah seorang lelaki yang riang yang hanya berfikir tentang melepak dengan rakan-rakannya dan menjadi gembira, manakala Lara adalah seorang yang bersemangat bebas yang mahu membuat jalannya di dunia sendiri. Mereka berempat bertemu di Wira Cinta, sebuah kelab yang dimiliki oleh Kak Pora di mana mereka semua belajar seni mempertahankan diri dan juga mengenali diri mereka sendiri, apabila Pinto, abang ipar Firman dari masa lalunya yang kelam muncul di kelab itu dan menuntut bahawa Firman kembali kepada kumpulan itu atau menghadapi akibatnya.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP3
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah keluarga yang terlepas bas terakhir untuk ke Genting selepas perjalanan mereka terganggu. Dalam keadaan terdesak, mereka menaiki sebuah bas lama tanpa logo yang muncul tepat jam 12 malam. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.desc: Liza Wang, Sammy Leung, William So, and Dickson Yu have teamed up to create a game show, inviting members of the entertainment family and guests to participate in a Werewolf Palace Edition game, revealing their foolish and clever sides. Guests will also tell exaggerated true or false stories to attract attention, allowing for speculation on whether the events are real or fake! Following her magical touch from the previous season, Ah Jie will again stir up topics at the Cheat Chat dinner table. Who can bring the most entertainment? Ah Jie has a wide circle of acquaintances, inviting guests from different fields, including Mak Ling Ling, Nancy Sit, Laurinda Ho, Philip Keung, Alex Fong, and Chin Ka-lok, to compete for the best performance and generous prizes! programme.title: Hands Up 2026 ((举起手来! 2026))

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes ((破毒强人))
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord Moses Chan. However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin Edwin Siu is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam Nancy Wu and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok Matthew Ho to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lams status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning Kelly Cheung. A war on drugs again breaks out

programme.title: News Treasury 2026 ((新闻掏宝 2026))
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments. (新闻展望是一个每周一次的节目,深入报道香港和世界各地的显著新闻报导,重点是对香港居民最为重要的社会问题,并邀请各部门人士、学者和专家讨论和分析根本原因和发展。)

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small (香港:永远不要太小)
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the citys structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of small spaces. (在时间的流逝和流逝中,描述城市缩影的当地商店越来越少见。然而,它们是城市结构的重要部分,也是香港精神不可替代的体现。铭记这一点,下到土宿主Louis Yuen带领观光员逐商店探索、参观时间充裕的现代商店,横跨日常生活的四个关键领域:服装、食品、住房和交通。他揭示了经营历史的商店、维护历史的困难以及几代人的故事,利用这些有形商店保存无形的记忆并展示小空间的持久美景。)

programme.title: Mystery Files ((苏联神秘档案))
programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous environmental factors that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. These factorsranging from changes in age and the rise of internet culture to the emergence of scams and other seemingly unusual reasonshave led to bizarre, worldview-shattering love stories in society. The TVB Plus live show Mystery Files hosted by Fire Lee, Jinny Ng, and Randal Tsang, invites people from all walks of life, celebrity guests, and relationship experts to discuss each episodes theme. With unique perspectives and thought-provoking questions, they boldly explore emotional dilemmas, while also welcoming viewers to join the conversation and solve problems together through the live chatroom and call-ins. (爱是一个极其复杂的话题,周围环境因素众多,可以改变我们的梦想和对浪漫的理解。 从年龄变化、互联网文化的兴起、骗局和其他看似不寻常的原因等诸多因素导致社会上出现奇特的、充满世界观的爱情故事。 由Fire Lee、Jinny Ng和Randal Tsang主办的TVB+实况节目神秘文件邀请各行各业的人、名人客人和关系专家讨论每个事件的主题。 他们以独特的视角和发人深省的问题,大胆地探索情感困境,同时也欢迎观众通过现场聊天室和来宾参与对话并共同解决问题。)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline ((最强生命线))
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health. (城市居民往往经历着繁忙的生活和高度压力,这使他们更容易受到健康问题的影响。最强的生命线帮助你解开健康的秘密。首先,该方案在常见的城市疼痛问题上有四大系列,包括头痛、肩部和颈部疼痛、背部疼痛和联合疼痛。每集都邀请医疗专家解释这些病症的原因,以及物理治疗师和锻炼专家进行适当的锻炼。随着东西方医学结合的趋势日益增长,甚至美国游泳冠军迈克尔·菲尔普斯也使用杯式疗法来缓解疼痛。因此,每集都包括传统的中国医学诊断,辅之以针线、杯子和Sanfu草药补丁疗法等疗法,这些疗法在最热的夏季特别合适。此外,中国医药从业人员分享了营养汤的食谱,所有这些都有助于调节和改善你的健康。)

programme.title: Try It? Really? Sr.2 ((試真D Sr.2))
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the Try It Out Team, returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. (Elena Kong再次领导团队,与张春龙、楚曼汉、吴宜宽和郑俊旺联合组建了Triing It Out团队,在第一季打完后以赞美和网友的热情赞美回来。 这次对台湾的新的深入探索将看到团队继续其放松、真实和自下而上的方式,引导观众深入岛屿心脏。 团队前往高盛、太南和台北,通过通过对极化的在线评论以及隐藏的宝石和鲜为人知的经验揭开有争议的商店,继续展示其精神。 团队致力于展示最真实的现场反馈,旨在创建实用的台湾旅游指南,避免观众陷入陷阱。)

programme.title: A Date with Goddess Sr.2 ((女神配对计划 Sr.2))
programme.desc: The dating reality show A Date with Goddess is back with a bang, and the second seasons love battlefield is all upgraded! Golden Matchmaker Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the heart-fluttering light and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the Peanut Team, providing live coverage of the goddesses dates. programme.title: Just Love
programme.desc: Judge KO HEI MAN HSUAN JESSICA HESTER and KOT KWOK KWONG CHAN KAM HUNG, SUNNY have agreed that MAN will concentrate on her career while KWONG will be taking care of the housework after they get married. Everything is in harmony until KWONGs father discovers MAN and KWONGs pre-marriage written agreement. Their relationship complicates ever since. To make things worse, KWONG breaks the agreement and demands to have his own career. MAN does not pay much attention at first until she finds out that KWONG, who is free from family burden, is having an affair. MAN learns to become more affectionate in the hope of saving the marriage. Unfortunately, the whole situation deteriorates when KWONG decides that MAN is too close to her ex-boyfriend, TAI CHI HUNG WANG CHIEH, DAVE, who is now MANs colleague. Who has the right to decide who should be in charge of earning money instead of running the family?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: Who Heals the Healers?
programme.desc: Doctors have said Youre sick countless times, but rarely have they heard it said to themselves. The news departments Fang Dongsheng team is out in force again, still searching for the patient who least resembles a patientthe doctor. They are usually quick, decisive, and accurate in their actions, accustomed to life and death, but when the roles are reversed, becoming patients or caregivers on the sickbed, they too experience avoidance and anxiety. The gods in the public eye are ultimately just ordinary people. How do doctors who save others save themselves? The new program, Doctor, Are You Sick?, delves into the difficult reality of doctors lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.title: Cause Of Death (死亡原因)
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased! (新任命的女性法医病理学家程志扬·赫拉·陈博士一直受到Lam Sum Willie Wai博士的启发。自从Chiyan博士还是个孩子以来,她一直渴望加入法医病理学处。然而,她在其上司Lam Sum博士开始新工作后被其上司Lam Sum博士所排挤。Lam Sum和他的前妻Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU高级检查员,不能站在一起。她们的女儿Lam Suet-lui离家出走,她们的道路又再次交叉。Chiyan 得到Lam Suet-lui的认可,她的工作态度是勤奋的,她与警官Ko Chun Mark Ma建立了联系。她们中的三个人逐渐成为精心协调的犯罪破坏三者。在经历了心脏病和失业之后,Chiyans兄弟Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng成为当地新闻记者。她和时髦的记者Tsim Pak-yu Nicolas Yuen从玩耍的对手发展到支持的合作伙伴。正如Chiyan的事业正在进步一样,她听到好朋友死亡的消息。她决心揭露真相并说出死亡的真相。)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: Mystic Nine Whats On Today ((Mystic Nine 即将上映电影))
programme.desc: In 1933, a mysterious ghost train arrives in Changsha, prompting military commander Zhang Qishan to investigate a hidden mine containing ancient secrets targeted by Japanese forces. Joining forces with opera singer Er Yue Hong and hotel heiress Yin Xinyue, Qishan and the citys powerful Mystic Nine families must navigate deadly underground traps to solve a century-old mystery and protect their nation from invasion.

programme.title: Who Heals the Healers?
programme.desc: Doctors have said Youre sick countless times, but rarely have they heard it said to themselves. The news departments Fang Dongsheng team is out in force again, still searching for the patient who least resembles a patientthe doctor. They are usually quick, decisive, and accurate in their actions, accustomed to life and death, but when the roles are reversed, becoming patients or caregivers on the sickbed, they too experience avoidance and anxiety. The gods in the public eye are ultimately just ordinary people. How do doctors who save others save themselves? The new program, Doctor, Are You Sick?, delves into the difficult reality of doctors lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot ((中文))
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation with limited resources, they had to use any means necessary to achieve their goals (了解当地习俗和文化的最佳方式是深入旅行,探索城市的每个角落,徒步旅行,探索整个城市的每个角落,欣赏沿途的风景,发现当地的生活和文化,迎接出乎意料的意外和挑战。 什乔里和蔡清春被一个制作团队引诱到台湾拍摄一个真实的节目。 从高雄机场开始,他们征服了300多公里,从太南到台北,在8天里访问了8个城市,每天只有1 000图亚,两个城市用他们的大脑解决交通和食品等问题,同时完成各种任务,甚至用有限的资源换房,他们不得不使用任何必要的手段实现其目标。)

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam John Chiang is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In Julian Cheung and Kun Hao Kuan Ron Ng, to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying Kelly Cheung, Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan Samantha Ko. programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: The Sunny Side of the Street
programme.desc: Hassan is a Pakistani refugee boy whose father has died in a car accident. A local taxi driver, Yat, then helps him flee Hong Kong. In the process, the two gradually develop a father-son relationship, until Hassan discovers the shocking truth about his fathers death

programme.title: Ready Or Rot ((Ready or Rot（A 2023 comedy film directed by Chen ... - 百度百科))
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi are finally getting married but pressure from Guys mother creates much friction between them. Meanwhile, Grey Bear suspects his wife of cheating on him and Ken faces the biggest crisis of his life when Jessica accidentally gets pregnant. Can they eventually solve their relationship problems?

programme.title: S Storm ((超凡战队))
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk witnesses a suspects murder while investigating an illegal soccer gambling case, but is unable to disclose information to Chief Inspector Lau due to his code of confidentiality, thereby hindering Laus investigation. While starting the case with mutual distrust, they end up reaching a rapport to uproot the crime syndicate.

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die ((提防老千))
programme.desc: Nick meets Teddy, a con artiste, when he is sent to prison for embezzlement, and Teddy teaches him all the gambling tricks. After their release, they team up with Teddys lover Lora, to take revenge on Dragon, who framed Teddy for his sentence. Nick though is seduced by Lora and they end up in an affair. Will Nick finally join Teddy in his revenge?

programme.title: Honey Money Phony ((“骗骗”喜欢你2))
programme.desc: After falling victim to a romance scam and being left with massive debt, Lin Qinglang teams up with con artist Ouyang Hui to reclaim her stolen money. As they set up an elaborate scheme against the scammers, the pair slowly develop unexpected feelings for each other amid lies, deception and twists of fate. (林清兰与骗子乌阳·胡伊合作,要求她收回被盗的钱.当他们建立了一个精心策划的骗子,夫妇在谎言,欺骗和命运扭曲中慢慢地对彼此产生意想不到的感觉.)

programme.title: Cold War 2 ((寒战2))
programme.desc: Sean Lau is now the Police Commissioner after the successful rescue operation Cold War. However, the culprits from the past not only dodged justice but even escalated their actions and kidnapped Laus wife. He breaks every protocol to get her back, which puts him under investigation. (刘肖恩在冷战救援行动成功后现在担任警务专员。 然而,过去的罪犯不仅逃避了司法制裁,甚至升级了他们的行动,绑架了刘易斯的妻子。 他打破了所有协议,将她送回去,这让他受到调查。)

programme.title: CJ7 ((长江7号：超萌特攻队))
programme.desc: Stephen Chow returns in this hilarious and heartwarming tale of a father and son who discover an adorable alien in the trash.

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman (无敌剑术士)
programme.desc: Longing to leave the martial world behind, Linghu Chong is drawn into a fierce conflict between rival factions. He falls for the enigmatic Dongfang Bubai, whose secret acts of kindness save him. But manipulated by Ren Wo Xing into believing she slaughtered his fellow disciples, Linghu Chong is driven into a tragic, life-or-death showdown. (为了摆脱武术世界,Linghu Chong陷入了敌对派别之间的激烈冲突。 他投身于神秘的Dongfang Bubai,他的秘密善行拯救了他。 但是,任Wo Xing操纵她相信她屠杀了其他门徒,而Linghu Chong却陷入了一场悲剧性的生死战。)

programme.title: Sifu VS Vampire ((大牌驾到))
programme.desc: This is a horror comedy about Sifu, Charlie Jiang, and his team of vampire hunters taking on the Vampire King who has been let loose on the streets of Hong Kong.

programme.title: Bounty Hunters ((赏金姐妹花))
programme.desc: A group of bounty hunters, including San, Yo, Cat, Swan and Bobo, are tasked to track down the culprit of a series of bombings that have plagued an international hotel group. Unfortunately, Swan, Cat and Bobo are kidnapped by the mastermind of the bombings. Can San and Yo save them? Will the bounty hunters accomplish their mission?

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, civilians hiding in Ji Xiang Studio are forced to develop film for the Japanese army, only to uncover photographic evidence of its atrocities. Risking execution if discovered, they decide to preserve the negatives and expose the truth, determined to reveal the horrors of the massacre to the world.

programme.title: Burning Stars ((孤星计划))
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai under the shadow of White Terror, agent Li Yi Min is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. He reunites with former allies to break through deadly traps. Amid the turmoil, a group of idealistic youths join the cause, risking everything to uphold the mission and find courage in a time of chaos.

programme.title: Unbeatable ((打不垮的哈罗德))
programme.desc: Former world boxing champion Fai meets the passionate young fighter Qi in Macau and agrees to train him for an upcoming MMA tournament. As mentor and student push themselves to the limit, Fai rediscovers his love for fighting, regains his passion for life, and learns to cherish the people who matter most.

programme.title: Victims ((法律与秩序：特殊受害者))
programme.desc: A ruthless Kuala Lumpur high school student kills his classmate, exposing the contrasting struggles of the victims mother and the murderers mother as they uncover their sons hidden secrets, while inching closer to a heartbreaking truth. (一位无情的吉隆坡高中生杀死同学, 揭露受害者母亲与杀人犯母亲在揭发儿子隐藏秘密时,)

programme.title: Echoes Of The Thunder ((速战))
programme.desc: Two half-brothers, Nam and Fire, are top racing drivers. In a racing challenge with Japanese driver Kenji, Nam causes a young racing driver to be seriously injured and is depressed. Fire stands up for Nam and decides to compete with Kenji in an illegal street car race. Who will win the race? Can Nam finally bounce back? (南和火这两个半兄弟是顶尖的赛车手。 在与日本司机健二的比赛中,南导致一位年轻的赛车手严重受伤,情绪低落。 南和火代表南和南决定与健二在一场非法的街头赛车比赛中竞争。 谁能赢得比赛? 南终于能反弹吗?)

programme.title: The Chinese Feast ((金玉满堂))
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: Everything Is Unknown ((意外人生))
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming receives his fathers will stating that he must attend his funeral at home to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he encounters his ex-girlfriend, her husband Hua Qi and his daughter whom he has never met. When Pan discovers that his daughter is being abused by Hua, he vows to save her but eventually fall into their trap (潘仪明的父亲会收到父亲的来函,说他必须在家里参加葬礼,以获得巨大的遗产。当他回家时,他遇到了他的前女友、她的丈夫华琦和女儿,而他从未见过她们。 当潘仪明发现他的女儿被华婆虐待时,他发誓要救她,但最终会落入他们的陷阱。)

programme.title: Iceman ((冰人))
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise. (被错误指控谋杀的明朝卫兵英被三兄弟追赶,直到一场激烈的战斗使四人被冰封。 四百年后,他们在现代香港觉醒,在那里他们必须在一个他们几乎无法辨认的世界重现其古老的世仇。)

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, civilians hiding in Ji Xiang Studio are forced to develop film for the Japanese army, only to uncover photographic evidence of its atrocities. Risking execution if discovered, they decide to preserve the negatives and expose the truth, determined to reveal the horrors of the massacre to the world.

programme.title: The Monkey King 3 ((西游记女儿国))
programme.desc: Monkey King, Pigsy and Sandy escort Monk Tang to retrieve the scriptures and accidentally head into the mysterious Female Kingdom. The Queen falls in love with Monk Tang at first sight, but her advisor orders Monk Tang and his disciples to be executed. As the four attract the appearance of River Spirit, the Female Kingdom is plunged into crisis!

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night ((风林火山))
programme.desc: Set in a snowbound, surreal Hong Kong, a tycoon who also secretly rules the drug trade is killed in an explosion, plunging the city into chaos. With police paralysed and the family businesses in turmoil, his youngest son vows to dismantle the familys empire, but is thwarted by his fugitive brother and his fathers followers fighting for control.

programme.title: Life Hotel ((奇妙酒店：大堂之外的生活))
programme.desc: Once a gangster, Li struggles to find work to pay for his fathers heart surgery. To earn money, he goes undercover to help shut down Life Hotel for a redevelopment project, but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As Li discovers that the hotel serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and empathy.

programme.title: Ride On ((怪物猎人物语 RIDE ON))
programme.desc: Master Luo, a washed-up stuntman, trains his beloved horse Red Hare to be a stunt horse. Due to his debts though, Red Hare may be taken away by the debtors. Master Luo has no choice but to seek help from his estranged daughter, and the incident ends up becoming a golden opportunity for them to reconcile. (卢老爷是一个被洗劫的特技演员,他训练他心爱的红兔马成为特技马。 但是,由于他的债务,红兔可能被债务国夺走。 卢老爷别无选择,只能从他离家出走的女儿那里寻求帮助,这一事件最终成为他们和解的良机。)

programme.title: 7-Man Army
programme.desc: In 1933, during the defence of the Great Wall at Gubeikou, seven Chinese soldiers are separated from their main force and tasked with defending the strategic outpost of Badaolouzi. Vastly outnumbered by Japanese troops and tanks, they make a last stand, fighting to the end in a powerful display of sacrifice and patriotism.

programme.title: Moods Of Love ((风花雪月))
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love or lust has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couples brothel. (关于一个人会去哪里去爱情或欲望的Song王朝时期的这篇文章有两个故事.第一讲述了一个恶魔般的法官,试图通过雇佣一个漂亮的妓女,诱惑一个佛教僧侣脱离自称独身.第二讲述了一个被剥削的年轻女孩,被迫在一个无私夫妇妓院工作.)

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders ((盗皇陵))
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of woman warriors and a group of ruthless bandits. The maverick teams up with the woman warriors to battle the bandits seeking to raid the emperors tomb.

programme.title: My Rebellious Son ((小子有种))
programme.desc: A corrupt official attempts to steal a priceless Buddha statue from a temple to please a group of Westerners. Luckily, Doctor Zhang and his son manage to defeat the Western boxers, the Japanese Kendo opponents and the Western longsword fighters with Chinese kung fu, thus saving the Buddha statue. (为了让西方人满意,一个腐败的官员试图从寺中偷走一幅无价的佛像.幸运的是,张博士和他的儿子成功地用中国功夫击败了西方拳击手,日本肯德罗的对手和西方长剑战士,从而挽救了佛像.)

programme.title: Summer Heat ((夏日情浓))
programme.desc: Aptly described by its original title of Money, Sex And Love, this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle... (简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介:简介)

programme.title: The Master ((大师))
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his masters rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gaos betrayal

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung And The Beauty ((乾隆皇与三姑娘))
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperors sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou. (皇帝隆在苏州遇见了一个著名的妓女,为了尽可能多地和她在一起,他建造了一个直接的地下道进入禁城.皇帝通过这种直接访问突然出现震惊了他的人民,但也是在这个时候他帮助需要的人,并破解了苏州的博业务.)

programme.title: Oath Of Death ((万箭穿心))
programme.desc: Three Sung loyalists become blood brothers to fight the tyranny of the Tartar invaders. To oust the oppressors altogether, Ma releases the kidnapped Tartar princess in a strategic effort to gain points with the invaders, but it soon becomes apparent that he desires both a great position and power, and will do anything to get it

programme.title: Rear Entrance ((后门))
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xus until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother. (徐女士是无子女的,每天都在远处看着一个孤独的小女孩在后门玩.她热情抚养了女孩,甚至从她的无关心的父母那里收养了她.)

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung ((龙虎会风云))
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shihs magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires. (的英雄是银幕原始功夫女士之一,Shih Szu,她扮演剑女孟洪.她必须与洛莱赫饰演的Fan Tien-Fu合作,寻找和保护王朝的皇家.的壮丽表演让她获得了另一个成功的女英雄角色.)

programme.title: The Happy Trio ((双星伴月))
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiaos fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness... (小,一个被困在城市的村子女孩,与一个善良的流浪汉和一个退休演员结交朋友.他们穷但幸福,尽管小的财富变得更好,当她成为一名歌手.)

programme.title: The Thundering Sword ((神剑震江湖))
programme.desc: Two disciples, Yu and Zheng, are sent by their master to track down the invincible weapon Thundering Sword to prevent villains from getting it. Yu encounters the daughter of a ruthless clan, Chiao, who is on her way to seek for the sword. They quickly fall for each other, but when Chiao accidentally injures Zheng, things become complicated. (和是两个门徒,他们的主人派他们去追踪无敌的武器雷剑,以防止恶棍获得它.遇到了一个无情的部落的女儿,,她正在寻找剑.他们很快就恋爱了,但当意外伤害时,事情变得复杂.)

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again ((老夫子奇趣录))
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: Ghosts Galore ((满天神佛))
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the ultimate witchcraft and teams up with his master to defeat them.

programme.title: Woman Of The Night ((蛇变惊魂夜))
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him. (电影讲述了爱情和痴迷的三个故事.第一部讲述了一个小学生,他有个视觉习惯,他间着两个女同房的女同房人.第二部讲述了一个办公室经理对他的秘书产生了热情.最后一个讲述是一段复杂的家庭戏剧,讲述了一个弱势的父亲迫使他的家人离开他.)

programme.title: Dead End ((归去))
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wens brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wens home and shoots her brother dead. (因在车辆崩后遇到了一个富有女孩文.因爱上了文,但文的兄弟不喜欢他,禁止他的妹妹见到他.他羞辱并打,所以拿着他在街上意外发现的枪到文的家,并射杀了她的兄弟.)

programme.title: The House Of 72 Tenants ((欢笑老弄堂))
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets ((双镯))
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of womens rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance ((明月刀雪夜歼仇))
programme.desc: Fu Hong Xue, a legendary swordsman, travels far to avenge his father, only to find the seven killers he tracks are already dead. Investigating with Yeh Kai, he learns they are alive, manipulated by disguise master Xiao Bie Li, who lures Fu into a trap. Yeh Kai aids him, but both end up trapped in a deadly blade formation.

programme.title: The Singing Escort ((青春万岁))
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen Lin Chong gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the bosss daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: That Man In Chang-an ((蒙面大侠))
programme.desc: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu. Liu sends his princess to Chang An to ask for help. The masked warrior protects the princess from attackers along the way and supports Liu to become the new Emperor. (汉皇帝死亡,他的皇帝卢夺取统治权力.她阴谋杀死王位继承人恒,但面具战士发现她的阴谋,并提醒.派他的公主去安求助.面具战士在路上保护公主免受攻击者,并支持成为新皇帝.)

programme.title: Tales of Larceny ((牛鬼蛇神))
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step. (连接了所有老板,僧侣,乞和盗窃者的事,)

programme.title: Godfather Of Canton ((黄埔滩头))
programme.desc: A docker, Lin Si Hai, accidentally saves Commissioner Cheng who then offers him a position in the police force. Lin is smart and soon rises through the ranks through treachery and corruption, before becoming a gangster. (林西海,一个船员,意外救了成长,然后他提供了警察的职位.林很聪明,很快通过叛国和腐败,)

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase ((钓金龟))
programme.desc: Its a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments. (剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧)

programme.title: The Tigress Of Shaolin ((麻疯怪拳))
programme.desc: Sam is being hunted as he discovers that the mayor and the chief of medical bureau are colluding with a drug dealer. He is saved by a fishermen family and works in their friends grocery but the grocery owner is killed when the enemies track Sam down. Sam escapes to Shaolin to learn the cudgel style of kung fu in order to avenge his friends. (萨姆被追捕,他发现市长和医疗局长和毒品贩子密谋.他被渔民家庭救出来,并在他们的朋友杂货店工作,但当敌人追踪萨姆时,杂货店主被杀害.萨姆逃到沙龙学习拳风格,以报复他的朋友.)

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy ((遗产五亿元))
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run. (一位残疾的亿万富翁给他长期失踪的女儿们发出了一封信,邀请她们去日本,希望他能找到一个值得继承的继承人来继承他的巨大的财富.)

programme.desc: Diagnosed with Lebers Neuropathy, homicide detective Tess Avery Dolly Lewis quits the police force after nearly getting her partner, Jake Campbell Daniel Gillies, killed. Unwilling to accept help, or even admit her new reality, Tess turns to an assistive app to help navigate the world around her while still passing as sighted. Through the EyesUP app, Tess finds an unorthodox partner in Sunny Patel Agam Darshi, an overly enthusiastic seeing eye guide working from her home in New York City who helps Tess investigate the brutal abduction of a young mother who may still be alive. But Sunny has a secret: shes an agoraphobe who only leaves her apartment through the eyes of her clients, and is hiding a violent event in her own past.

programme.title: SIGHT UNSEEN ((未曾目睹))
programme.desc: When the hit and run victim from one of Tess Dolly Lewis former cases awakes from a coma, Sunny Agam Darshi encourages Tess to track down new leads even though shes no longer on the force. Tess ex-partner Jake Campbell Daniel Gillies inherits Tess case files along with a new partner, Leo Li Tony Giroux, who is quick to dismiss the case as a dead end. As Tess makes progress, she discovers the incident is connected to a notorious unsolved murder. Meanwhile, Tess best friend Matt Jarod Joseph encourages Tess to open up about her vision loss to Jake. Sunny, desperate to help Tess find leads, reveals her surprising financial situation and a dilemma on her doorstep - the very doorstep of her apartment that she is terrified to cross.

programme.title: SIGHT UNSEEN ((未曾目睹))

programme.title: Africas Wild Horizons ((非洲狂野地平线))

programme.title: Africas Wild Horizons ((非洲狂野地平线))

programme.title: Africas Wild Horizons ((非洲狂野地平线))

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 施政報告提出成立加快粵港澳三地規則銜接和機制對接專組，律政司副司長張國鈞接受大鳴大放專訪時表示，大灣區的發展是一個很重要的經濟引擎，香港能否享受到大灣區帶來的紅利，關乎粵港澳三地規則銜接和機制對接是否做得好張國鈞負責統籌專組，會先和15個政策局對接，有望今年年底或明年年初組成專組，盡快和灣區內的城市研究有哪些議題大家有共同意願，覺得重要，需盡快解決；當取得中央同意就去展開，希望在本屆政府餘下不足一年內能至少有一兩項做好，成為灣區銜接對接的一個作用，輻射到灣區內的其他城市，一起用這個灣區標準，令到整個粵港澳大灣區真的可以成為國際的一流灣區張國鈞表示過去一段時間和内地部門接觸，一些題目兩地覺得重要的，有共同興趣的項目，均是與經濟發展或和民生息息相關影響巨大的項目該個銜接和機制對接專組，在大灣區發揮一個法律的作用：希望用法律部門做好牽頭作用，將法律和政策一併大家去談，我想這個是推進我們這個規則，銜接和機制對接的一個有效途徑他表示大家已摸到一些共識，也累積了一些經驗，希望透過法律平台提速提效實踐，加快粵港澳大灣區的發展，共識一個統一的標準，達致我們所謂的灣區標準：將來我們希望透過這個粵港澳大灣區，能夠將我們國家的這些標準向外輸出，我想這個是我們可以發揮的作用

programme.desc: 有人認為狗是人類最忠心的朋友，然而香港近月發生狗隻襲擊人與狗的事件，令社會原本積極宣掦人寵共融的氣氛瞬間逆轉有大型狗隻被敵視飼養了一隻重近五十公斤都柏文犬的YoYo指，人們現時對狗隻存有品種及體型歧視，途人會特意探頭觀看，他們反應兩極，部分會說牠很靚仔，也有人說這些大狗會咬死人YoYo聞言非常生氣蒙受影響的還有寵物友善餐廳由於有客人對與狗為鄰感到反感，有食肆東主礙於左右做人難而放棄寵物友善牌照，在人和狗的衝突下，是否必須站邊？寵物友善餐廳東主Derek慨嘆道狗隻襲擊事件，有人歸咎於餵哺流浪動物，及義工為狗隻進行捕捉絕育放回，導致狗隻於社區聚集，埋下炸彈這些流浪狗是從哪裡來？是附近停車場貨倉魚塘等養作看門口，後來搬走便把牠們棄養動物救援組織毛守救援創辦人陸家捷Kent，十年前已開始為流浪動物做絕育，但指因為義工團體缺乏地方收容，才把流浪動物放回原地動物保護團體認為，人類不善待動物，例如放養棄養或用籠鏈長期綁著飼養，才是引發人狗衝突的主因，團體認為政府應該更新防止殘酷對待動物條例，應該通過動物福利法，增加謹慎責任一項，要求主人善待動物籠鏈犬關注組織發起人小青說人與狗，究竟是敵人還是朋友？善待與否，對人狗關係帶來甚麼影響？

programme.desc: 함께 하는 대한민국을 위한 EBS 사회 공헌 프로그램

programme.title: 모여라 딩동댕
programme.desc: 유아들이 일상생활 속에서 갖게 되는 흥미로운 궁금증과 호기심을 중심으로 다양하게 탐구해나가는 사고력 증진 프로그램입니다. 유아들의 눈높이에서 제기된 참신한 호기심 아이템을 선정하고, 선정된 아이템은 유아 스스로 추론하고 탐구할 수 있는 직접 체험과 다양한 활동 및 시청각 매체를 총동원하여 전개해나갑니다. 이러한 다양한 경험과 활동을 통해 유아들은 새로운 자극을 받게 되고 또 다른 도전감과 새로운 호기심으로 발전해나가면서, 창의적인 아이로 자라날 수 있을 것입니다. 사랑스러운 모야멍, 재미있는 웅이형, 친절한 동이언니, 그리고 우리의 친구 뚝딱딱 삼총사와 함께 호기심의 나라로 날아가볼까요?

programme.title: 로보카 폴리
programme.desc: 아름다운 섬마을 브룸스타운에는 날마다 크고 작은 사고가 끊이지 않는데... 사건이 일어날 때마다 로봇으로 변신하는 용감한 구조대, 로보카 폴리 출동!

programme.title: 어린 철학자
programme.desc: lt어린 철학자gt는 정답을 맞히는 아이가 아니라, 자신만의 생각을 가진 아이로 자라도록 돕는다. 질문하고, 사유하고, 자신의 기준을 세우고, 주장할 줄 아는 인간으로 성장하는 시간! AI 시대, 대체 불가능한 인간이 되는 가장 근본적인 힘 - 철학 하는 힘을 키운다.

programme.title: 극한직업
programme.desc: 우리 사회에는 상상을 초월하는 극도로 힘든 작업환경 속에서 일하는 사람들이 있다. 이런 극한의 직업에 종사하는 사람들의 삶을 밀착 촬영하여 생생하게 보여줌으로써 역경을 극복하고 살아가고자 하는 사람들의 숭고한 의지와 잃어가고 있는 직업정신의 가치를 되돌아본다.

programme.title: 일요시네마 lt월드 트레이드 센터gt
programme.desc: 9.11 테러로 무너진 국제무역센터 매몰 현장에 갇혀있다가 가까스로 구조된 두 경찰관의 실화를 대형스크린에 연출한 재난 휴먼 드라마.

programme.title: 세계테마기행 1부
programme.desc: 세계테마기행은 단순한 여행 정보 프로그램에서 벗어나, 자유로운 배낭여행자만이 느낄 수 있는 살아있는 체험기를 전해드리고자 기획된 프로그램. 스페인에서 칠레, 남아공에서 알래스카에 이르기까지 전 세계를 직접 발로 뛰며 제작되는 세계테마기행은 찬란한 문명 유적지와 자연유산은 물론 다양한 방식으로 삶을 영위해 가는 세계인들의 숨은 일상까지 생생히 보여준다

programme.title: 세계테마기행 2부
programme.desc: 세계테마기행은 단순한 여행 정보 프로그램에서 벗어나, 자유로운 배낭여행자만이 느낄 수 있는 살아있는 체험기를 전해드리고자 기획된 프로그램. 스페인에서 칠레, 남아공에서 알래스카에 이르기까지 전 세계를 직접 발로 뛰며 제작되는 세계테마기행은 찬란한 문명 유적지와 자연유산은 물론 다양한 방식으로 삶을 영위해 가는 세계인들의 숨은 일상까지 생생히 보여준다

programme.title: 쌀롱하우스
programme.desc: 한 시대를 풍미했던 옛 스타들의 인생 희로애락 사연 있는 쌀롱 하우스에서 신나게 풀어낸다. 보이는 라디오가 아닌, 들리는 TV! 옛 스타들의 인생의 주제곡도 들어보고 한 평생 건강하게 살기 위한 나름의 건강계획도 듣는 시간! 웃고 떠들고 흥겨운 수다가 시작된다.

programme.title: 친절한 진료실
programme.desc: 전문성은 기본, 환자 눈높이용 친절한 설명과 유머로 어려운 건강 정보도 쉽게 술술 당신의 건강 궁금증, lt친절한 진료실gt에서 밀착 진료해 드립니다.

programme.title: 중독자들

programme.title: 신중한 강연쇼
programme.desc: 5천년 중국 역사 비틀기부터 2016년 현재 중국의 민낯까지! ALL ABOUT CHINA! 지금까지 당신이 알고 있던 중국은 잊어라! 중국과 한국의 명사들에게 듣는 중국인도 모르는 중국의 진짜 이야기! quot표절 천국이냐 한류를 넘어선 콘텐츠 강국이냐, 대륙의 문화 콘텐츠의 민낯은? 슈퍼 차이나인가 차이나쇼크인가? 미래의 차이나 리포트는?quot 당신이 모르던 진짜 중국에 대한 이야기를 들려준다. 한중 대표 지식인 6인의 버라이어티 강연쇼! 같은 주제에 다른 시각 또는 각자의 관점으로 이야기 하라! 신중한 강연쇼는 통찰력으로 무장한 한국과 중국의 지성 교양인 6인이 출연하여 매회 한국 대툐와 중국 대표 강연자가 한가지 테마를 두고 강연을 펼친다. 다양한 테마는 기본, 한중 양국의 다채로운 시선과 생각을 공유할 수 있는 새로운 형식의 버라이어티 강연쇼로 시청자들에게 다가갈 수 있을 것이다.

programme.title: 요괴워치
programme.desc: 아주 평범한 동네, 진달래 마을에 사는 엄청 평범한 초등학교 5학년 민호는 어느 여름 날 기묘하고 하얀 생물인 위스퍼와 만나게 된다. 민호를 따라다니던 위스퍼는 신기한 시계 요괴워치를 민호에게 건네고.. 그날부터 마을 곳곳에 나타나는 요괴들이 보이기 시작한다! 일상 생활에서 벌어지는 곤란한 사건의 모든 것은 요괴가 원인이다?! 민호는 사건을 일으키는 요괴들을 설득하고 때때로는 싸우며 사건을 해결한다. 그리고 요괴들과 친구가 된다! 오늘은 또 어떤 새로운 요괴를 만나게 될까?

programme.title: 파파독
programme.desc: 늘 사랑스럽고 씩씩한 골목대장 별이. 하지만 그런 별이도 가끔은 쓸쓸한 모습을 보일 때가 있다. 그 이유는 별이의 가장 친한 친구이자 든든한 보호자가 되어 주었던 아빠가 해외 출장을 갔기 때문인데... 오늘도 홀로 가방을 챙기고 학교로 향하는 별이, 그런데 왠 개 한마리가 앞을 가로 막는다. 별이를 보며 반갑다는 듯 꼬리를 흔들던 개! 갑자기 두발로 일어나더니 사람처럼 말을 하기 시작하는데... 별아, 내가 니 아빠다, Im your farther! 어이없는 상황에 눈이 휘둥그래진 별이, 그리고 감정이 북받치는 듯 눈물을 흘리는 개! 과연 어떻게 된 일일까?? 배꼽 잡는 소동과 따뜻한 가족의 사랑이 담긴, 아빠가 개가 됐어요!, 개 변신 애니시트콤 파파독의 이야기가 시작된다.

programme.title: 짱구는 못말려 10
programme.desc: 조금은 건방지고 장난을 좋아하는 5살 유치원생 신짱구가 주인공으로, 부모님은 물론 주위의 어른들이 짱구가 일으키는 장난들에 휘말리고 마는 일상을 재미있게 그린 코믹 애니메이션. 투니버스에선 2001년 첫 방영을 시작하였으며, 현재까지도 시청자들에게 가장 큰 사랑을 받고 있는 작품 중 하나이다. 특히, 이번 lt짱구는못말려10gt은 짱구 출판 20주년, 방송 10주년을 기념하여 방영되는 시즌으로, 국내에선 한 번도 공개되지 않은 새로운 시즌이 방영될 예정이다.

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.desc: Un viaggio alla scoperta delle specialit e delle diverse tradizioni culinarie italiane. Il duo di conduttori attraversa la penisola raccogliendo notizie e curiosit sui prodotti gastronomici pi caratteristici del Belpaese.

programme.title: Caduta libera
programme.desc: Un concorrente al centro dello studio, sopra una botola, rischia di cadere alla prima risposta sbagliata. A sfidarlo, dieci avversari pronti a incorrere nella stessa sorte in un duello a suon di domande.

programme.title: Il minestrone
programme.desc: Francesco e Giovannino, due vagabondi della periferia romana, per un equivoco vengono rinchiusi nella cella di sicurezza del commissariato in cui detenuto il Maestro, un accattone specializzato nelle fughe da ristoranti, trattorie e tavole calde.

programme.title: Are You Afraid of the Dark?
programme.desc: Billy e la sua sorella Karen usano il tredicesimo piano della casa come parco giochi. Ma un giorno, una misteriosa azienda produttrice di giocattoli si insedia al tredicesimo piano e invita Karen a provare alcuni dei suoi giochi.

programme.title: I luoghi di Magnifica Italia
programme.desc: Alla scoperta del Belpaese, delle sue coste, dei rilievi, delle piane e delle citt da unangolazione sorprendente: quella data dalle riprese aeree. Un modo unico per conoscere quello scrigno di bellezze e storia che chiamiamo Italia.

programme.title: Il capo perfetto

programme.title: Animali Meccanici
programme.desc: Gli Animali Meccanici vivono e giocano in un luogo molto speciale, un universo colorato che, proprio come loro, in continua trasformazione.
